role: Owner Steam check and installation HTTP response

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Only schema is required; absent optional response fields mean null. The staff readback is preserved without reinterpreting its unknown fields.

firstMissingSignal.description: none, a fixed refusal, or one bounded signal token; never apt output

staff.description: Verbatim parsed success readback, never cached or logged

ledger_written.description: Present on install responses; false means the deed line fell back to the process event stream

POST /api/v1/console/steam/install.accept_license: Only explicit JSON boolean true dispatches --accept-license; every other value refuses with 422 before starting the staff deed.

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
